body.label: Target
body.html: One adjacent enemy restraining you or a willing ally, or one enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and end one ordinary restraint maintained by that target on you or an adjacent ally.

surges.html: The freed creature may move 1 unit without triggering the target's movement Reactions.
On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Breaker
rider.html: After a hit, spend 1 Combo to preserve your Stance when you are next forcibly moved before your next turn, ignoring its normal movement-ending clause once.
